title: DeepSwap review: pricing, credits, API and alternatives
summary: DeepSwap review covering photo, GIF and video face swap, current credit costs, HD access, API availability, limitations, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**DeepSwap is worth considering for credit-metered video face swaps with long-video and multitasking options. Its clearest strength is published unit costs for photo, gif and video swaps plus api access. The main limitation is full access and credit packs must be combined to estimate real production cost. Magic Hour is the stronger fit when you want image, GIF and video face swap inside a broader image, video and audio workspace.**


This vendor-authored review was checked against[DeepSwap official product and policy pages](https://www.deepswap.ai/) on September 20, 2026. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative. It is a documentation review, not a retained cross-tool quality benchmark.


## What is DeepSwap?


DeepSwap is an AI face-swap product for replacing a face in an image or video. Published unit costs for photo, GIF and video swaps plus API access. Use only media you own or have permission to edit, and obtain explicit consent from every identifiable person.


## What DeepSwap does well


Credit-metered video face swaps with long-video and multitasking options. Its workflow removes much of the manual masking and compositing required by conventional editing. That convenience does not prove every output is accurate: inspect eyes, teeth, hairlines, skin edges, occlusion, lighting and identity across the full clip.


## DeepSwap pricing and access


DeepSwap’s current pricing page lists video face swap at one credit per 15 seconds, photo face swap at 0.1 credit and GIF face swap at one credit. Full Access includes 20 monthly credits, HD face swap, priority processing, multitasking and videos up to 30 minutes. Verify the checkout price and failed-job behavior before buying.


## Privacy, consent and commercial use


Face media is sensitive. Review DeepSwap’s current privacy and terms pages in the purchase flow before uploading client or confidential material, and preserve consent and source-rights records for every identifiable person.


A commercial-use label does not clear publicity, copyright, trademark or contractual rights. Keep written consent, source licenses and disclosure records. Never use face swap to impersonate, deceive, harass or create intimate imagery without consent.

## How to test DeepSwap fairly


Use one permitted portrait, one difficult side angle and one short motion clip. Keep resolution, duration and source files constant. Record attempts, processing time, charged credits, watermarks, export resolution and whether the output was usable without manual repair.


Reject outputs with identity drift, unstable jaw or hair boundaries, flicker, incorrect occlusion, changed expression, altered skin tone or artifacts around glasses and hands. Compare cost per accepted output rather than cost per generation.


## Verdict


DeepSwap has a defensible place for credit-metered video face swaps with long-video and multitasking options. Full access and credit packs must be combined to estimate real production cost. Test one representative job and verify current policies before committing sensitive media or recurring production.
